scope: Real hosted Cron → pg_net → authenticated Edge consumer → Postgres runtime CAS. Synthetic CPU graph, no model, browser or external implementation. Recovery tests additionally invoke the authenticated dispatcher.

checks.name: authenticated Worker creates a queued CPU diagnostic without model credentials
Cron executes CPU output 50 without a browser or manual dispatcher call
duplicate enqueue cannot re-execute a completed diagnostic
background AI cannot be enabled without the processor model connection
stop survives delivery; expired leases pause; unknown effects require reconciliation
